result.brief: 该文从理论上分析自回归语言模型中连续隐状态迭代（连续思维、pause step）的可辨识性、规范自由度与开环误差障碍，给出隐空间转移与读出匹配贝叶斯预测器的条件。
result.reason: Theoretical analysis of latent/continuous-thought processes in autoregressive LMs, with gauge and identifiability results on latent transitions and readouts; connects to continuous latent reasoning.
